report_card.goal: Complete the ReviewResultData v2 contract contender prototype and capture the winning shape.

friction.note: The demo needed a provenance bug fixed before the contender scores were usable.

verification_burden.note: Ran the demo smoke, direct aggregate evaluator, typecheck, and Fallow audit; prototype test findings were intentionally not acted on.

observations.summary: Full claim-safe ReviewResultData won the prototype because it keeps allowed claims and split readiness in the reducer result.
The minimal contender treated an opaque run id as trusted until provenance was carried separately from run-key grouping.
